formulation.plant: planar3 LTV-linearized numerically at every reference-horizon step
formulation.execution: OSQP resolves each control step; only first command is applied.

reward_cost_mapping.position_error: quadratic Q position, swept relative to effort
reward_cost_mapping.velocity_error: fixed quadratic Q on surge/sway/yaw rate
reward_cost_mapping.control_effort: quadratic R with delivered-thrust regularization rebalanced to 2e-5
reward_cost_mapping.command_delta: soft quadratic penalty mirroring task action-change penalty; no hard slew constraint

consolidated_reference_table_note: LOS-SPEEDCAP-v2 is retained and renamed; it models no actuator lag. MPC-v1 models the plant's documented actuator lag, an inherent predictive-model distinction rather than an extra constraint or configuration advantage.
